[[Yingko the Skull Claw]] is a [[Crimson Skull]] [[boss]] that appears in [[Sunqua Vale]].

== Location ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Sunqua Vale}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Demonic Flesh}}
* {{skill icon|Enfeebling Blood}}
* {{skill icon|Oppressive Gaze}} 

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Bolt of Linen]]
* [[Copper Crimson Skull Coin]]
* [[Crimson Skull Cape]]
* [[Yingko's Claw]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Be careful when approaching this boss.  The paths of three patrol groups will cross the area where he is.
* Also, when Yingko is attacked, three other Crimson Skull enemies will appear to defend Yingko.

== Trivia ==
* Yingko might be a reference to the main character's alter ego "the Warlord Ying Ko" from the 1994 film, "''[[w:The Shadow (film)|The Shadow]]''".
